name: mentions
title: Mentions
description: A textarea that suggests people when you type @.
a11y: The textarea keeps its native textbox role (ARIA does not allow combobox on a textarea) and adds aria-haspopup="listbox", aria-autocomplete="list", aria-controls while the list is open and aria-activedescendant for the highlighted option; the list is a listbox of options.
ArrowDown/ArrowUp move the highlight, Enter or Tab insert the mention, Escape closes the list without inserting; focus never leaves the textarea.
A polite status region announces how many suggestions there are, and when they are loading or empty.
Async loading ignores answers for outdated queries so the list never shows stale results.
